nodes.summary: For $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$, the basin of zero of $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ is the set of $z \in \mathbb{C}$ whose forward orbit tends to $0$, that is, $f_\lambda^{n}(z) \to 0$ as $n \to \infty$, where $f_\lambda^{n}$ denotes the $n$-th iterate of $f_\lambda$.
nodes.title: Basin of attraction of zero

nodes.summary: For the cubic family $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ with $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$, the boundary of every parameter component is a Jordan curve. Here a parameter component is a connected component of the set of $\lambda$ for which every critical point of $f_\lambda$ lies in the immediate basin of zero of $f_\lambda$.
nodes.title: Roesch's theorem on the boundaries of cubic parameter components

nodes.summary: Let $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ for $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$. The statement is that for every parameter component $U$, that is, every connected component of the set of $\lambda$ for which every critical point of $f_\lambda$ lies in the immediate basin of zero of $f_\lambda$, the boundary $\partial U$ of $U$ in $\mathbb{C}$ is a Jordan curve.
nodes.title: McMullen's question on Jordan boundaries of cubic parameter components

nodes.summary: For a parameter $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$, the cubic polynomial map $f_\lambda : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is given by $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$.
nodes.title: Cubic family

nodes.summary: For $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$, a point $c \in \mathbb{C}$ is a critical point of $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ when $f_\lambda$ has complex derivative $0$ at $c$, that is, $f_\lambda'(c) = 0$.
nodes.title: Critical points of the cubic family

nodes.summary: For $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$, a set $V \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ is the immediate basin of zero of $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ when $0 \in V$, $V$ is contained in the basin of zero of $f_\lambda$ (the set of $z$ with $f_\lambda^{n}(z) \to 0$), $V$ is connected, and every connected set $W \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ with $0 \in W$ that is contained in the basin of zero of $f_\lambda$ satisfies $W \subseteq V$. Thus $V$…
nodes.title: Immediate basin of zero

nodes.summary: A set $S \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ is a Jordan curve when there is a continuous injective map $f$ from the unit circle $\{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| = 1\}$ to $\mathbb{C}$ whose image is exactly $S$.
nodes.title: Jordan curves in the plane

nodes.summary: A set $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ is a parameter component when it is a connected component of the parameter set, the set of $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$ for which every critical point of $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ lies in the immediate basin of zero of $f_\lambda$: $U$ is nonempty, contained in the parameter set and connected, and every connected set $W \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ with $U \subseteq W$ that is contained…
nodes.title: Parameter components

nodes.summary: The parameter set is the set of $\lambda \in \mathbb{C}$ for which some immediate basin of zero $V$ of $f_\lambda(z) = \lambda z^2 + z^3$ contains every critical point of $f_\lambda$.
nodes.title: Parameters with both critical points in the immediate basin

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
